steps.title: Start With The Problem
steps.text: Three short blocks set out what changed, what breaks and one real example.

steps.title: Pick Your Starting Point
steps.text: Each card opens with a situation. Choose the one closest to yours.

steps.title: Move Between Parts
steps.text: Open the menu to see every part of the guide and the pages inside it.

steps.title: Check Any Claim
steps.text: Every named source is a link to the original report or to the MCP specification.

steps.title: Switch Day And Night
steps.text: Use the toggle in the top bar to change between night and day mode.
